artifacts.purpose: human-readable earnings-call risk, opportunity, catalyst, and review summary
line-delimited triage records for stale data, missing evidence, and high-impact language
prior/current deterministic score movement and reviewer interpretation

cautions: Educational research review only; not personalized investment, legal, accounting, tax, buy, sell, or hold advice.
Artifact paths are local file handoffs and should be regenerated from current fixtures before portfolio or thesis use.
Review queue JSONL is triage input; humans must verify missing evidence, stale data, and high-impact language against source documents.
Compare output reflects deterministic keyword-score movement between snapshots, not real-world valuation or risk conclusions.
Downstream portfolio and thesis systems own exposure sizing, approval workflow, retention policy, and investment decisions.
safety_notice: Educational research review only. This tool does not provide personalized investment, legal, accounting, tax, buy, sell, or hold advice. Verify source materials and note that stale/static data may no longer reflect current conditions.

source_boundaries.analyst_questions: source-provided questions or prompts; they are not treated as factual claims
source_boundaries.management_claims: source-provided company statements or prepared remarks; verify against filings and transcripts
source_boundaries.user_synthesis: user-authored notes, tags, and deterministic tool scores; review prompts, not advice
